description: Create a dynamic creative with asset_feed_spec. Meta automatically combines different images, videos, titles, bodies, and CTAs to find the best performing combinations.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the creative in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

asset_feed_spec.description: JSON string of asset_feed_spec with arrays: images (hash), videos (video_id), bodies (text), titles (text), descriptions (text), call_to_action_types

degrees_of_freedom_spec.description: JSON object for Advantage+ creative controls, including creative_features_spec.image_animation, video_filtering, and video_uncrop

destination_spec.description: JSON object controlling the destination; set destination_type=WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT to opt out of the v26 Shops default

object_story_spec.description: JSON object containing the associated page_id and optional instagram_user_id

wamo_whatsapp_identity_spec.description: JSON object with wamo_whatsapp_identity_id or whatsapp_phone_number for WhatsApp Status ads; sent at the creative's top level

name: create_dynamic_creative
